socially responsible business practices have a positive impact in terms of value creation for the SME.
socially responsible business practices have a positive influence on SMEs and their financial performance.
socially responsible business practices towards employees, society and customers have a positive influence on SME performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how social responsibility can be translated into value creation in a small firm.

the relationship between the values of an individual and the value of a firm, and it is shown that socially responsible behaviour of an SME owner–manager is positively related to the value of the firm.
the question of whether socially responsible management practices of SMEs can be considered to have an effect on the financial performance of a company.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the social responsibility of a firm is reflected in the behaviour of its management and that this behaviour in turn is reflected in the firm's performance.
socially responsible business practices can contribute to value creation for a company and its owner.
socially responsible business practices can create value.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the socially responsible business practices are not a cost factor for SMEs.
the socially responsible management practices of an owner–manager have an influence on the firm's performance, which in turn has a positive effect on the owner–manager's personal values.
socially responsible business practices are a key factor in the success of a company and that the personal values of a company's executives play an important role in this regard.
The main takeaway from our work is that
socially responsible management in SMEs can be beneficial for the firm and its owner–manager.
socially responsible management in SMEs is not just a nice-to-do, it is a must-to-do.
the social responsibility of SME executives is not just a moral issue, but that it is also an economic issue.
